description: Asset universe registry. Each entry maps a semantic role to a ticker-list file and declares downstream capabilities.

equity.single_name.description: Single-name equities filed with SEC (subset of Nasdaq-100). Source of truth for SEC ingestion filers and equity options scraping.
equity.single_name.notes: Expansion beyond 48 tickers requires updating config/reference/ticker_to_cik.json via Scripts/tools/SEC_generate_cik_map.py.

etf.broad_market.description: Broad-market equity index ETFs. Primary sentiment / beta benchmarks.

etf.commodity.description: Commodity-backed ETFs used as safe-haven / inflation proxies.

etf.all.description: All ETFs we track (broad market + commodity).

options.scrape.description: Full universe for yfinance options-chain scraping (single-names + ETFs).

sec.filers.description: Tickers to be fed to the SEC EDGAR ingester (10-K/10-Q/8-K/Form-4). Alias for equity.single_name.
